answer: Hardware enclave attestation counters Sybil attacks by requiring agents to run inside secure enclaves that produce cryptographic quotes. Registered against a public attestation beacon, these proofs validate agents trading real-world goods, such as nursery garden crops or agave nectar. An attacker incurs the scarce, verifiable cost of acquiring distinct physical silicon chips per identity. However, this relies on centralized manufacturer root keys and vulnerable side-channel surfaces.
